messages:
oliver-peopleops: Quick thread for Zoe (starts Mon). Background check cleared but passport shows a middle name not present on offer docs. Candidate is in SIN (Singapore). Need to confirm acceptable supporting docs for I-9-equivalent verification and handle device shipping/customs.

sara-recruiter: Zoe said she has a signed statutory declaration from a lawyer (affidavit) that ties names together, plus recent bank statement and passport. She can get a notary at the Australian High Commission nearby if needed.

oliver-peopleops: For US I-9 we usually accept passport OR passport+secondary. Since she's offshore, propose we accept: passport scan + statutory declaration + live video verification. Require notarized original to arrive within 7 business days. @intl-vendor any issues with that?

intl-vendor: That's workable. We recommend adding a witnessed attestation step and a recorded ID check. Also flag customs: laptop shipping must declare "company equipment" and include CN23 with value 0 to avoid import VAT in some cases. Provide invoice/pro-forma labeling for customs.

it-support-bot: Device request made: MacBook Pro 14. Provisioning 48h. Shipping from EU hub to SIN ~4-6 business days depending on carrier and customs. Suggest we ship DHL Express with commercial invoice type "Permanent Export" and CN23 value 0 as vendor suggested.

payroll: Payroll needs a verified government ID copy on file before first payroll run; collecting statutory declaration + passport is ok as temporary. Also need home country tax form (SG IR8A equivalent) but we handle that after onboarding. When will benefits SSO go live?

oliver-peopleops: Plan: 1) Ask Zoe to upload passport scan + statutory declaration to secure portal today. 2) Schedule 20-min recorded video ID check Fri 10:00 SGT. 3) Ship device DHL Express once provisioning done, mark as PERMANENT_EXPORT and CN23 value 0. 4) Require notarized originals by day+7. 5) Notify payroll when docs attached so they can allow payroll activation.

sara-recruiter: Zoe available for Fri 10:00 SGT. She's okay with courier labeling as "company equipment". She asked about reimbursement for notary fees and customs handling.

oliver-peopleops: We'll reimburse reasonable notary/embassy fees under expense code ONB-INTL. Customs fees: we typically pre-pay duties when needed and reclaim, but with CN23=0 we hope to avoid duties. If carrier charges import VAT, file expense with receipts.

zoe-newhire: Uploaded passport and statutory declaration just now. Thanks all. One more: can I get SSO access to Slack + email Day 0 morning? Manager wants a pre-boarding check-in.

it-support-bot: We can create pre-boarding access as a guest account Day 0 if security approves. Standard policy: full SSO/email only after verified ID. Exception possible for read-only Slack access. Ticket IT-6291 opened.

oliver-peopleops: Security note: grant pre-boarding Slack guest with limited channel access (welcome, manager-1:1) and no repo or credential access. Add NDA acknowledgement before access.

payroll: Once we see the uploaded docs we'll flag payroll queue to permit contract activation. Please tag payroll when video recording is attached.

oliver-peopleops: Thanks everyone. Action items: Sara will confirm Fri slot; Intl-vendor will share customs pro-forma sample in thread; IT will queue guest access; payroll will standby. Will close after DHL tracking posted and notarized originals received within 7bd.

intl-vendor: Pro-forma sample:

```text
DESCRIPTION: Company equipment - MacBook Pro
VALUE: 0 USD (CN23: 0)
EXPORT_TYPE: Permanent Export
```

oliver-peopleops: Noted. Marking this thread "Singapore name-affidavit + customs plan".
